expertise: AI readability and front-loaded actionability review

semantic_votes.rationale: Within this Skill, each candidate means each validation check under consideration. Deriving effects is the necessary input to tool, workspace, and authority matching, so the instruction is scoped, actionable, and does not force a vendor mechanism.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The targeted-validation-selection Root and Registry contract when an active Profile is selecting candidate validation checks for changed paths and acceptance.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Keep candidate scope bounded to checks under consideration, derive effects from current repository and task evidence, and record unknown rather than inventing a classification.

semantic_votes.rationale: The phrase one or more defines a multi-label effect taxonomy; it is not a duration, pass threshold, response status, or organizational quota. Full context explicitly separates unknown effects and uses the labels to constrain execution.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The per-command classification section of targeted-validation-selection, where a candidate check may legitimately have multiple simultaneous known effects.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Retain the multi-label wording, preserve unknown as a separate outcome, and re-review only if the count becomes an operational success or policy threshold.

semantic_votes.rationale: The review Profile has read, search, and execute-read-only tools and is contractually non-modifying. Requiring both actual tool support and a non-modifying classification prevents unsupported or mutating execution while remaining directly actionable.
semantic_votes.authority_or_condition: The review-agent Profile and targeted-validation-selection contract when review-agent independently runs a validation check.
semantic_votes.mitigation: Evaluate the actual command effects and active host tools; mark unsupported, unknown, or modifying checks planned, blocked, or unrun instead of executing them.

limitations: This independent review evaluates static Root readability, front-loaded actionability, and consistency with the current Registry and Profile contracts; it does not prove host enforcement or runtime command effects.
